extension.description:
Sign in with your Starz account and play through InputStream Adaptive with Widevine DRM.
IN DEVELOPMENT: sign-in, browsing, search, My List and playback work in test builds.
On a software Widevine L3 CDM (every desktop, LibreELEC, and L3 Android) expect standard definition; HD needs a hardware Widevine L1 Android device.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Starz. Use only with your own subscription; third-party clients may be against the service's terms.
